Summary of a selIndex Object

Source: R/print.selIndex.R
summary.selIndex.Rd

Returns and prints the full ranked index table from a selIndex result, with one row per line sorted from highest to lowest index value. The header reports the index type, combining weights, number selected, and the expected genetic gain per environment at the selection threshold fixed when selIndex was called.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'selIndex'
summary(object, ...)

Arguments

object

A "selIndex" object returned by selIndex.

...

Currently unused.

Value

A data.frame with columns for the line identifier, one GEBV column per environment (multivariate only), Index, and Rank, sorted descending by Index.

See also

selIndex, print.selIndex, plot.selIndex

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
summary(si)
top10 <- head(summary(si), 10)
} # }
